training_loss: Composite Hero objective on randomly masked action sequences and sampled balanced future targets. Do not compare numerically to inference-policy CE.
composite_validation: Fully masked action sequence with full-horizon targets and recorded-line contextualization. This is not a searchless deployment rollout.
validation_pool_note: Intermediate validation uses the first 2048 positions of the final 8192-position pool. Initial versus terminal composite means therefore do not use exactly the same pool size.
matched_inference_policy_loss: All four models use the same 8192 sequential positions and played-next-move targets. CE is in nats, normalized over legal moves. Historical Hero1 gets its recorded current-only transform; new models and raw BT4 receive full history. Native, DFM1 and DFM8 are distinct inference policies, with raw BT4 native only.
value_targets: Soft search WDL from each position's actual root_q/root_d, in that position's side-to-move perspective. These are search targets, not game-result ground truth.
wdl_horizon_metric_labels: The generic serialized *_by_horizon_h1 through h9 names index the nine prediction slots. For these current-inclusive pilots, h1 means actual H0/current, h2 means H1, ..., h9 means H8. wdl_current_loss is explicitly H0.
calibration_note: Composite-validation ECE is the mean of batch-level ECE values, not one global pooled calibration estimate.
tournament: Six 128-color-pair searchless development matchups, 1536 games total. DFM1 for new models/Hero1; native for raw BT4. Primary uncertainty is the existing marginal bounded-pair Hoeffding interval; not simultaneous across comparisons. Relative logistic Elo is matchup-specific, not a calibrated absolute rating.
causal_limits: Single seed. New-versus-new is the matched value-formulation comparison. New-versus-historical Hero1 also changes history, data, precision and schedule/training length. No held-out promotion, source-game non-overlap or searched-strength claim.
